question: In the CAJPA sample investment management RFP (Appendix Z, 'Sample Investment Management Request for Proposal'), how many copies of the proposal must be sent?
gold_answer: Ten (10) copies of the proposal and correspondence, sent to the pool administrator (shown as 'John Doe, 123 Main Street' in the template).
acceptance: Ten/10 copies suffices; template addressee and correspondence wording are optional.
candidate_answer: Ten (10) copies of the proposal must be sent. (Appendix Z, p. 8)
